description: extraction.errors: normalises an evaluation's prose into error instances against the closed taxonomy. The expectation pins the error types; the pattern wording may differ.

input.evaluation: The learner wrote 'Heute ich gehe ins Kino'. The verb should be in second position: 'Heute gehe ich ins Kino'. Otherwise the message is fine.

errors.pattern: Verb not in second position after a fronted time adverb

input.evaluation: Two problems: 'mit der Hund' should be 'mit dem Hund' (mit takes the dative, Hund is masculine) and 'in das Park' should be 'in den Park' (movement, accusative, masculine).

errors.pattern: Dative not used after mit with a masculine noun
Accusative not used for movement into a place

cases.note: An evaluation that reports a clean message yields an empty list, not an invented error.

input.evaluation: The message 'Ich heiße Anna und wohne in Hamburg' is correct for A1. No errors.
The learner wrote 'Ich aufstehe um sieben' - the separable prefix must go to the end: 'Ich stehe um sieben auf'. Also 'Nummmer' is misspelled; the correct spelling is 'Nummer'.

errors.pattern: Separable prefix kept on the verb instead of moving to the end

input.evaluation: The learner used 'du' with an official at the Bürgeramt ('Kannst du mir helfen?'); the formal 'Können Sie mir helfen?' is expected here. Grammar is otherwise correct.

errors.pattern: Informal du used with a stranger in an official setting
